description: When Life Happens, You Shouldn’t Be On Your OwnMy grandfather died when my mom was just nine years old. That left my grandmother, Pauline Valentine, to raise her kids on her own.She worked hard. She carried the weight of her family for years. She didn’t ask for much.When she finally retired, it wasn’t because she had a big savings account.It was because of Social Security.That monthly check gave her stability. It gave her rest. It gave her dignity.I’ve seen that same kind of difference in other
